verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud platform. A cloud console could plausibly ship AI-generated insights over a user's usage or data, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only infrastructure and developer building blocks: preinstalled Lambda Stack, JupyterLab, a usage page and a Grafana GPU dashboard. None of these is a built-in feature that produces AI-generated insights or suggestions from user data, and the only agent tooling is an unofficial third-party MCP server.
